description: This file defines the StartModuleExecutionListener class used in test setup for the OpenMRS platform. It handles module startup and Spring context refreshes before running tests, especially when using custom annotations like @StartModule.

classes.name: StartModuleExecutionListener
classes.description: A test execution listener that manages module startup and Spring context refreshes before tests, using annotations to specify which modules to load.

methods.name: prepareTestInstance
methods.description: Prepares the test instance by loading specified modules, restarting context, and cleaning up bean definitions.

methods.name: removeFilteredBeanDefinitions
methods.description: Removes bean definitions related to modules that need to be reloaded during testing.

methods.name: afterTestClass
methods.description: Cleans up after all tests in a class, shutting down modules and restoring bean definitions.
